description: The file defines the PimCsvDataImport class responsible for importing CSV data into Employee entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for validating and mapping CSV fields to Employee properties, handling external service dependencies, and ensuring data integrity during import.

classes.name: PimCsvDataImport
classes.description: Class responsible for importing employee data from CSV format, validating fields, and creating Employee entities.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Main method to import employee data from an array, validating fields, creating Employee object, and saving via EmployeeService.

methods.name: getDateTimeIfValid
methods.description: Converts a string date to DateTime object if valid; returns null otherwise.

methods.name: getNationalityIfValid
methods.description: Retrieves a Nationality entity matching the provided name if valid.

methods.name: getNationalityService
methods.description: Returns the NationalityService instance, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: getCountryCodeIfValid
methods.description: Returns the country code for a valid country name.

methods.name: getCountryService
methods.description: Retrieves the CountryService from the container.

methods.name: getProvinceIfValid
methods.description: Returns province code if a valid province name is provided.

methods.name: isValidPhoneNumber
methods.description: Validates whether the provided phone number string is valid.

methods.name: isValidEmail
methods.description: Validates whether the provided email string is valid.

methods.name: isUniqueEmail
methods.description: Checks if the email is unique, unless empty.

methods.name: isUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Checks if the employee ID is unique, unless empty.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Utility method to determine if a string is null or empty.
